original_question: On which chromosome is the gene that encodes the protein secreted by malignant cells in an endodermal sinus tumor located?

final_qi.question: On which chromosome is the gene that encodes the protein secreted by malignant cells in an endodermal sinus tumor located?
final_qi.long_answer: Malignant cells in endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumors characteristically secrete alpha-fetoprotein (AFP). The AFP protein is encoded by the AFP gene, which is mapped to the long arm of human chromosome 4 (region 4q13).
